newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Oct CPI inflation seen falling to 8.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Oct CPI inflation seen falling to 8.3 pct.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation could fall to 8.3 percent year-on-year in October from 8.5 percent in September, a monetary source told Reuters.
The CPI inflation figure for October is expected to be released later today.
A Reuters informal poll of 15 economists and bankers produced a mean forecast of 8.4 percent year-on-year, the same as the median for October. Forecasts ranged from 8.6 to 8.3 percent.

National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou, Deputy Finance Ministers George Drys and Nick Christodoulakis were meeting with Prime Minister Costas Simitis on Wednesday to discuss the 1997 budget, the prime minister's office told Reuters. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
